label: Tree
depicts: Pine tree outline with layered zigzag canopy panels above a small base
use_when: Use when the interface wants a conifer tree with stacked zigzag branch layers.
avoid_when: Do not use for round leaf or palm trees when the layered pine silhouette matters.

label: Tree
depicts: Round tree canopy inside a circle outline with a centered trunk
use_when: Use when the interface wants a round framed tree rather than a free standing tree silhouette.
avoid_when: Do not use for plain free standing trees when the circular outer ring should stay visible.

label: Tree
depicts: Leaf shaped tree outline with one canopy panel and a short center line
use_when: Use when the interface wants a simple single leaf canopy tree shape.
avoid_when: Do not use for the pine or palm forms when the canopy is one leaf shaped outline.

label: Tree
depicts: Palm tree outline with three curved canopy loops and a bent stem line
use_when: Use when the interface wants a tropical tree rather than a broadleaf or pine tree.
avoid_when: Do not use for the other tree icons when the bent trunk and curved fronds matter.

label: Attachment
depicts: Open paper clip with a hooked top and one inner loop
use_when: Use when the interface wants a more open paper clip with a visible hooked top opening.
avoid_when: Do not use for the classic diagonal clip when the top hook opening should remain visible.
